description: This file implements a gRPC client for the Kubernetes Container Runtime Interface (CRI), providing methods to manage container lifecycles, retrieve stats, handle logs, and communicate with the runtime server.

classes.name: remoteRuntimeService
classes.description: A gRPC client implementation of the Kubernetes CRI RuntimeService, providing methods to interact with container runtimes.

methods.name: NewRemoteRuntimeService
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new remoteRuntimeService instance, establishing a gRPC connection to the runtime endpoint.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the gRPC connection to the runtime server.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime version information.

methods.name: RunPodSandbox
methods.description: Creates and starts a pod sandbox.

methods.name: StopPodSandbox
methods.description: Stops a running pod sandbox.

methods.name: RemovePodSandbox
methods.description: Removes a pod sandbox.

methods.name: PodSandboxStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a pod sandbox.

methods.name: ListPodSandbox
methods.description: Lists pod sandboxes based on filter criteria.

methods.name: CreateContainer
methods.description: Creates a container within a specified sandbox.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Starts a container.

methods.name: StopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Removes a container.

methods.name: ListContainers
methods.description: Lists containers based on filter criteria.

methods.name: ContainerStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a container.

methods.name: UpdateContainerResources
methods.description: Updates resources allocated to a container.

methods.name: ExecSync
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously inside a container.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Prepares a streaming endpoint to execute a command in a container.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Prepares a streaming endpoint to attach to a running container.

methods.name: PortForward
methods.description: Prepares a port forwarding session from a PodSandbox.

methods.name: UpdatePodSandboxResources
methods.description: Updates resources for a pod sandbox.

methods.name: UpdateRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Updates the runtime configuration, such as network settings.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime status.

methods.name: ContainerStats
methods.description: Gets statistics for a container.

methods.name: ListContainerStats
methods.description: Lists statistics for containers based on filter.

methods.name: PodSandboxStats
methods.description: Gets statistics for a pod sandbox.

methods.name: ListPodSandboxStats
methods.description: Lists statistics for pod sandboxes.

methods.name: ReopenContainerLog
methods.description: Reopens the log file for a container.

methods.name: CheckpointContainer
methods.description: Triggers a checkpoint of a container.

methods.name: GetContainerEvents
methods.description: Streams container events.

methods.name: ListMetricDescriptors
methods.description: Lists available metric descriptors.

methods.name: ListPodSandboxMetrics
methods.description: Lists metrics for pod sandboxes.

methods.name: RuntimeConfig
methods.description: Retrieves runtime configuration details.
